summary: the KRFFS root's five data operations hold the mount's lock, and the lock serves its waiters in the order they asked: tests/host/fixtures/krffs_root_lock.c over the operations and the lock extracted unchanged from a private copy of vfs.c

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
f=tests/host/fixtures
python3 $f/extract.py $f/kfs_data.inc -f $s/fs/vfs.c 'struct ns_turn' mount_base ns_my_turn vfs_ns_lock vfs_ns_unlock kfs_read_locked kfs_write_locked kfs_truncate_locked kfs_fsync_locked kfs_readdir_locked kfs_read kfs_write kfs_truncate kfs_fsync kfs_readdir
${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -g -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -pthread -c tests/host/fixtures/krffs_open_threads.c -o threads.o
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -pthread -I $s -I $s/lib -I $s/proc $f/krffs_root_lock.c threads.o $s/lib/kstring.c $s/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/krffs_root_lock

edits.find:
rc = kfs_read_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);
    vfs_ns_unlock(mnt);
edits.replace: rc = kfs_read_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);

edits.find:
vfs_ns_lock(mnt);
    rc = kfs_read_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);
edits.replace: rc = kfs_read_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);

lines: krffs-root-lock: fail: kfs_read holds the mount's lock wherever it reaches the image

edits.find:
rc = kfs_write_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);
    vfs_ns_unlock(mnt);
edits.replace: rc = kfs_write_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);

edits.find:
vfs_ns_lock(mnt);
    rc = kfs_write_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);
edits.replace: rc = kfs_write_locked(mnt, handle, buf, count, offset);

krffs-root-lock: fail: kfs_truncate holds the mount's lock wherever it reaches the image

edits.find:
rc = kfs_readdir_locked(mnt, handle, cursor, ent);
    vfs_ns_unlock(mnt);

vfs_ns_lock(mnt);
    rc = kfs_readdir_locked(mnt, handle, cursor, ent);

faults.name: line
faults.summary: a namespace lock that serves whoever finds it free, not the first in line

lines: krffs-root-lock: fail: vfs_ns_lock serves a waiter before a holder that let the lock go and asked again
